newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD jumps ahead of earnings announcement.
newsitem.headline: KDD jumps ahead of earnings announcement.

text.p: Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) shares jumped on Thursday afternoon as dealers bought the shares ahead of the firm's earnings announcement after the market closes, brokers said.
As of 0443 GMT, the shares were up 400 yen or 5.30 percent at 7,950, the 12th largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Some brokers said there was avid interest in the shares from foreign investors, which was contributing to the rise in price.
KDD earnings are due to be announced at 0600 GMT.
